    },
    {
      "year": 2025,
      "revenue_cr": 178660,
      "net_income_cr": 20900,
      "eps": 21.55
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "Revenue growth of approximately 9-10% per annum driven by capacity additions (NTPC's aggressive capex of ~Rs 17,800-20,400 crore annually on new power projects) and higher fuel cost pass-through tariffs; the FY2022 YoY revenue jump of ~19% (consolidated: Rs 1,32,669 crore vs Rs 1,11,531 crore) was anomalously high due to fuel cost inflation flowing through regulated tariffs and post-COVID demand recovery, so the 3-5 year CAGR of ~8-10% is used as the projection basis with a modest upward adjustment for capacity expansion.",
    "Net profit margin remains broadly stable at 12.5-13% of revenue, supported by the regulated cost-plus tariff model ensuring recovery of fuel and finance costs, with PAT growing at 7-9% annually; high leverage (total debt well above Rs 2 lakh crore) and finance costs of ~Rs 9,300 crore constrain margin expansion, while incremental capacity commissioning and JV profit contributions provide modest upside."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2022 consolidated revenue from operations surged ~19% YoY to Rs 1,32,669 crore, which is anomalously high compared to the estimated 3-5 year CAGR of ~8-10%, driven primarily by elevated fuel cost pass-through under CERC regulations and post-pandemic demand recovery rather than structural capacity growth. Accordingly, the forecast reverts to the underlying 3-5 year CAGR of ~9-10% blended with management's capex signals of Rs 17,800-20,400 crore per year indicating meaningful capacity additions. Balance-sheet leverage is high (non-current borrowings ~Rs 1.62 lakh crore consolidated) but manageable given the regulated utility model with assured cost recovery; EPS is computed on approximately 969 crore weighted average equity shares (implied from standalone EPS of Rs 16.62 on PAT of Rs 16,111 crore)."
}

Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

RESPONSE FORMAT: Begin your response DIRECTLY with the opening brace { — no reasoning or text before the JSON.

  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}
  ],
